invariants.rationale: The method expects the parameter 'layer' to be non-null to access its methods and fields.
The first line in the method calls layer.getCombinedTintColor(), so this should not return null.
The method checks if region is null, so both are possible at entry (non-trivial possibility of either case).
Opacity is typically expected to be in [0,1] range.
The supportsTransparency method will always return either true or false.
